incident-bot: INCIDENT: gpu-23 ECC correctable error spike detected — paging oncall (severity: P2). Link: https://redwood.alerts/inc/1754321127

Aisha (oncall): seeing the page. grabbing runbook now. any customer-facing errors? :eyes:

Sofia: Telemetry shows degraded tail latency for a subset of hosted text-gen requests hitting that rack. Not all requests, ~3 customers had >200ms tail latencies and a small % of token OOMs.

Rajat: pulling node logs. dmesg shows repeated ECC warnings: 
```
GPU 0: Correctable ECC error at 0x1f4a2
GPU 0: Correctable ECC error at 0x1f4b7
GPU 1: Correctable ECC error at 0x1f4ec
```
Likely hardware intermittent, maybe a DIMM issue. Temps look normal (~68C).

Marta: VRAM pressure on the node briefly peaked at 94.6% around 09:12 UTC, but reclaiming happened. Utilization was also high on few pods (98%).

Aisha (oncall): for now, let's triage with minimal customer impact: 1) cordon/drain gpu-23, 2) move affected pods to spare capacity, 3) inform CS for customers with elevated latency. anyone object?

Rajat: ACK. Running cordon/drain: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-23
kubectl drain gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
(Will watch eviction progress.)

ops-bot: Drain job started for node gpu-23 by Rajat. 12 pods to evict.

Sofia: I'll update the dashboard and add an alert annotation for the latency graph. CS-Alerting: pinging you to notify customers under the affected routes.

CS-Alerting: On it — sending targeted messages to the three customers who saw >200ms tail increases. No wide-scale customer outage.

Aisha (oncall): Drain completed and node marked unsched. Evicted workloads are scheduled on dedicated spare pool, tails stabilizing. marking incident as mitigated in the bot but we need follow-up: hardware RMA or deeper diagnostics.

Marta: Agree. Also want to address alerting noise: the ECC correctable alert fired multiple times across the fleet yesterday and today but most were single-correctable events that didn't correlate with customer impact. This one had a cluster of correctables + VRAM pressure + high util, so paging was correct. But we should tune to avoid noisy pages when single correctables happen.

Rajat: Proposed immediate tuning: change paging rule so we page only when correctable ECC error rate > 3 in 5m on a node OR if ECC errors combined with VRAM pressure > 92% or GPU util > 95%. That way transient single events stay as warn-only. Example PromQL: 
```
# page if >3 correctable errors in 5m
sum(increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total{node="$node"}[5m])) > 3

# OR page if errors + mem pressure
(sum(increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total{node="$node"}[5m])) > 0 and
 (avg_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes{node="$node"}[2m]) / avg_over_time(gpu_memory_total_bytes{node="$node"}[2m])) > 0.92)
```
We'll need to implement as an Alertmanager route that pages only when severity == "page". Lower-level single-event alerts stay as pageless warnings to the #eng-sre channel.

Sofia: Also add thermal hysteresis: only page for temp > 85C sustained for 2m. add suppression for maintenance windows and operator-initiated drains.

Marta: We should add a Grafana dashboard "GPU Health - Thermal|ECC|VRAM" with panels for: ECC rate (per-node), ECC event logs (links to Loki), VRAM used%, GPU util distribution, recent drains & cordon events. Add a quick link to RMA runbook and last 24h nodes with >1 correctable event.

Aisha (oncall): Good. Action list: 
- Rajat: implement PromQL changes and Alertmanager route change (target: 2h)
- Sofia: create GPU Health dashboard & annotation queries (target: EOD)
- Marta: run fleet scan for nodes with >1 ECC correctable in last 24h and open HW tickets (target: today)
- CS-Alerting: customer messages sent; follow up if customers report issues
- Aisha: write short incident note and tag for postmortem; set follow-up meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC

Rajat: one more note — add a safeguard in the runtime to prefer model fallbacks when GPU VRAM pressure > 93% to reduce OOMs (we can toggle via rollout flag). I'll open a PR.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-INC-2026-314 for follow-up alert tuning and RMA tracking.

Sofia: I'll add the PromQL panels and share the draft dashboard link here when ready.

Marta: scanning fleet now. preliminary list: gpu-23, gpu-11, gpu-77 flagged with >1 correctable in 24h. Opening hardware tickets.

Aisha (oncall): thanks all. marking as mitigated in the incident bot — keep monitoring for 1 hour and then close if no regressions. We'll take the alert tuning changes as a post-incident task and schedule a verification window to ensure we didn't under-alert.

incident-bot: Incident RW-1754321127 mitigated by oncall at 2025-11-03T09:28:00Z. Follow-ups: RW-INC-2026-314 (alert-tuning), RW-HW-809 (RMA).

Sofia: quick note for postmortem — include exact PromQL and Alertmanager route diff, timeline of the correctable spike, and customer latency tail plots.

Aisha (oncall): I'll draft the postmortem template and ping owners. thanks everyone :thumbsup:"
